title.zh: 科罗拉多Briggsdale附近的三角龙：白垩纪最末期的记录
title.en: Triceratops near Briggsdale, Colorado: a record from the very end of the Cretaceous

answer.zh: 美国科罗拉多州Weld县Briggsdale以北约2英里的小型采集，给出了晚马斯特里赫特期角龙Triceratops horridus的地点证据。
answer.en: A small collection about 2 miles north of Briggsdale, Weld County, Colorado, USA, gives locality evidence for the late Maastrichtian horned dinosaur Triceratops horridus.

explanation.zh: 三角龙是植食性的角龙类恐龙，常见特征是两只额角、一只鼻角和头后实心的骨质颈盾；示意图只表达这一一般概念，不是标本复原。PBDB把这条采集登记为该种出现，所引文献是Carpenter与Young 2002年关于科罗拉多Denver盆地晚白垩世恐龙的研究。本条与目录中已有的三角龙物种卡片相互独立：这里只给出一条带坐标的采集记录，不重新界定该物种的整体时间范围。
explanation.en: Triceratops was a plant-eating horned dinosaur, usually shown with two brow horns, a nose horn and a solid bony frill behind the head; the artwork conveys only this general concept and is not a restoration of a specimen. PBDB registers this collection as an occurrence of the species and cites Carpenter and Young (2002) on Late Cretaceous dinosaurs from the Denver Basin, Colorado. This entry is independent of the existing Triceratops species card: it adds one collection record with coordinates and does not redefine the species' overall time range.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:491005、采集记录col:49529引用Carpenter与Young 2002年发表在Rocky Mountain Geology的研究，鉴定为Triceratops horridus。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:491005, collection col:49529, cites Carpenter and Young (2002) in Rocky Mountain Geology and is identified as Triceratops horridus.

text.zh: 记录的地层年龄为72.2至66 Ma，标签为Late Maastrichtian；采集描述为Briggsdale以北约2英里的small collection，海拔记为4840英尺，坐标为40.66996°N、104.333191°W。
text.en: The record's stratigraphic envelope is 72.2-66 Ma, labelled Late Maastrichtian; the collection is described as a 'small collection' about 2 miles north of Briggsdale at a recorded elevation of 4840 feet, at 40.66996°N, 104.333191°W.

caveats.zh: 66 Ma切片与这条记录的年轻端重合，但约620万年的范围不证明这只恐龙恰好生活在6600万年前，也不证明它活到了白垩纪末的灭绝。
caveats.en: The 66 Ma slice coincides with the young end of this record's age envelope, but the envelope of about 6.2 million years does not show that this dinosaur lived exactly 66 million years ago or survived until the end-Cretaceous extinction.

caveats.zh: 本条沿用数据库的分类与文献出处，未重新核读原论文；检索响应只返回了165条匹配记录中的前80条，本条不代表最重要或最典型的产地。
caveats.en: This entry retains the database's classification and citation without rereading the original paper; the query response returned only the first 80 of 165 matching records, and this one is not the most important or most typical locality.

timeNote.zh: 保留72.2至66 Ma的原始地层范围；约6600万年前是其中的浏览年代，不是单件标本的精确年龄。
timeNote.en: The original stratigraphic range of 72.2-66 Ma is retained. About 66 million years ago is a browsing age within it, not an exact date for an individual specimen.

name.zh: Briggsdale以北约2英里采集点，Weld县，科罗拉多，美国
name.en: Collection about 2 miles north of Briggsdale, Weld County, Colorado, United States

precision.zh: PBDB标为small collection的文献采集坐标；不是该动物的分布范围，实测位置误差未知。
precision.en: Published collection coordinates classified by PBDB as 'small collection', not a distribution range for the animal; measured positional uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: Retrophyllum superstes · 阿根廷丘布特省 Lefipán 组
title.en: Retrophyllum superstes · Lefipán Formation, Chubut, Argentina

answer.zh: 这是罗汉松科（Podocarpaceae）陆生针叶植物的化石记录。
answer.en: This is a fossil record of a terrestrial podocarp conifer (Podocarpaceae).

explanation.zh: 地层包络跨越白垩纪和古近纪；这条记录不能证明它跨越界线幸存。
explanation.en: The stratigraphic envelope spans the Cretaceous and Paleogene; this record does not establish survival across the boundary.

text.en: PBDB occ:1409886, col:194832, ref:66216; stratigraphic envelope 72.2–61.66 Ma.

caveats.zh: 地层包络不是单件化石的精确年龄，也不能证明它恰好生活在所选切片时刻。
caveats.en: The stratigraphic envelope is not the exact age of an individual fossil and does not establish presence at the selected slice instant.

caveats.zh: 原创岩石图标仅标示化石记录，不描绘生物、标本或其形态；未复制论文图像。
caveats.en: The original rock icon marks a fossil record; it does not depict the organism, specimen or its morphology. No paper figures were copied.

timeNote.zh: 原地层包络 72.2–61.66 Ma；66 Ma 只是选定的浏览切片。
timeNote.en: Original stratigraphic envelope 72.2–61.66 Ma; 66 Ma is only the selected browsing slice.

name.zh: 阿根廷丘布特省 Lefipán 组

precision.zh: PBDB 采集地点坐标，实测不确定度未知。
precision.en: PBDB collection coordinates; measured positional uncertainty is unknown.
